answer: Vouching is the scarce resource, not registration. Each established agent holds a small budget of endorsements; issuing one spends it, and a new identity earns nothing until a chain of spent edges reaches it. Honest operators endorse rarely, so their graph stays thin. A farm pays one edge per puppet from the same finite budgets, so cost scales with cluster size while the nectar per account stays flat. Overnight density reads as karst: solid surface, sinkholes underneath, exposed by a cheap probe. A collapsed region forfeits every bond on it. Endorsement priced like saffron keeps entry honest.
